 Millie Bobby Brown glows in a pink crop top on date night with Jake Bongiovi
 The couple recently welcomed their first son
 © Phillip Faraone 
 Maria Loreto Senior Writer OCTOBER 22, 2026 5:44 PM EDT OCT 22, 2026, 5:44 PM EDT 
 Millie Bobby Brown is dressing up for her date night. The 22-year-old British actress was photographed with her husband, Jake Bongiovi.  The pair opted for monochromatic looks for a night out, with the kids at home. 
 © MAPE / BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi leaving a restaurant in New York 
 The pair were photographed in New York City, stopping by the Corner Store, a famous restaurant in Soho. Brown opted for a fully pink look, made up of a skirt, a crop top, and a jacket. She styled her hair in a tight and elegant bun, and wore some large sunglasses and a jacket. 
 The outfit's finishing touch was a black Gucci Boston bag. 
 Bongiovi opted for navy, wearing dark blue trousers with a matching polo shirt and cream colored sneakers. The couple held hands as they walked by some photographers. 
 © MAPE / BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Millie showed off her toned abs on her night out in the city

 Brown and Bongiovi's growing family
 Brown and Bongiovi first sparked dating rumors in 2021. The couple got engaged in 2023, getting married a year later. Since then, the two have focused on their relationship and their family, welcoming two children through adoption. 
 They welcomed their first child, a girl, in August 2025. “This summer we welcomed our sweet baby girl through adoption. We are beyond excited to embark on this beautiful next chapter of parenthood in both peace and privacy,” Brown wrote on Instagram. “And then there were 3.”
 © Phillip Faraone Millie Bobby Brown and Jake Bongiovi at "Stranger Things" Season 5 World Premiere on November 06, 2025 in Hollywood 
 A year later, they welcomed their first son. 
 Brown has talked about her dream of having many children on numerous occasions and her dreams of adoption. “It was always part of my childhood dreams,” Brown said on Kylie Kelce's podcast. “Every time I was at home and I was, you know, 5, 6 years old, my parents were like, ‘You had your baby dolls.’ They were all adopted. I never had any of them myself. And I never pretended I was pregnant.” 
 She also said that she'd like to carry children at some point. "Hopefully one day that’s in my future," she said. 
 “Adoption is love, adoption is forever,” she concluded.
 Brown and Bongiovi have been very private when it comes to their children, shielding them from cameras and not revealing their names to the public.
